svg.title: Market bias posteriors by fold
svg.desc: Each point is a posterior median; whiskers are 90 percent intervals. Dashed lines mark no bias.

g.text: Market bias posteriors by fold: median and 90% interval
Dashed: no bias (κ_D = 1, δ = 0). δ_M is the market level relative to the goals model; δ_M + log κ relative to the xG latent.
